verdict.rationale: Event subscription is a fair question for a scriptable terminal emulator, but the evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. kitty's remote control (`kitten @ ls`, `send-text`, `get-text`) is verified hands-on, but it is inbound command-and-query control, not webhook event delivery, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
